description: Change an existing automation rule of a form: the trigger (on_create/on_update), the actions (send_email/update_record/…), the email, and above all the CONDITIONS and the UPDATE FIELDS (update_fields). A conditions/update_fields list that is passed REPLACES the existing one whole; one not passed is not touched. The answer holds the rule's resulting structure — show the person that, from the answer, not from your own request.

action_id.description: Rule ID from list_action_rules — as a string, as returned (takes priority over name)

conditions.description: The FULL new list of conditions under which it fires (replaces the old one)

condition.description: is, is_not, contains, is_empty, is_not_empty, less_than, greater_than and so on

do_not_send_data_if_criteria_matches.description: true = when the conditions match, the record is NOT saved and the person reads `message` instead; false = the record is saved as usual

email_column.description: Name or ID of the field with the recipient's email

email_recipient_source.description: 0 = the given addresses, 1 = from a field of the form, 2 = the record's owners

emails.description: Addresses the mail always goes to, comma-separated. "me" = the person you are talking to (their own account's address): «email me», «notify me», «let me know» — never ask them for it. The answer's emails says the address it became

entity_id.description: ID of the form the rule lives in

message.description: The text the person reads: after the save (show_message) or instead of it (do_not_send_data_if_criteria_matches)

name.description: Rule name to search by (if action_id is not passed)

numbers.description: Written phone numbers, comma-separated — when it is not a number from the record

run_webhook.description: false stops the automation calling its webhook (the webhook is kept); true only for an automation that has one — make it with create_webhook

settings.description: Deprecated: the same simple attributes as a hash. An unknown key is an error.

show_message.description: Show `message` AFTER the record is saved. It refuses nothing.

sms_column.description: The field of this form that holds the phone the text goes to (name or id)

update_fields.description: The FULL new list of fields the rule sets in the record (replaces the old one; switches update_record on)

name: update_action_rule
